name: dead-claude-skills
description: deadmade's personal Claude Code setup: own skills plus the third-party plugins used on every machine.

plugins.name: dead-skills
plugins.description: Default bundle: personal skills and agents, and pulls in every other plugin in this marketplace as a dependency.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring to filter false positives

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance.

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
plugins.description: Analyze codebases and recommend tailored Claude Code automations such as hooks, skills, MCP servers, and subagents.

plugins.name: rust-analyzer-lsp
plugins.description: Rust language server for code intelligence and analysis (requires rust-analyzer on PATH)

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: csharp-lsp
plugins.description: C# language server for code intelligence (requires csharp-ls on PATH)

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript/JavaScript language server for enhanced code intelligence (requires typescript-language-server on PATH)

plugins.name: pyright-lsp
plugins.description: Python language server (Pyright) for type checking and code intelligence (requires pyright-langserver on PATH)

plugins.name: nix-lsp
plugins.description: Nix language server (nixd) for code intelligence (requires nixd on PATH)

plugins.name: mcp-basic
plugins.description: Basic MCP servers for every machine: Context7 (up-to-date library docs).

plugins.name: mcp-github
plugins.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server (repos, issues, PRs, Actions). Opt-in per machine.

plugins.name: mcp-azure
plugins.description: Azure DevOps Server MCP server (self-hosted, PAT). Opt-in per machine, configure with /plugin configure.

plugins.name: mattpocock-picks
plugins.description: Curated Matt Pocock skills that complement superpowers: all productivity skills plus grilling with domain docs, spec → tickets and architecture deepening. Opt-in.

plugins.name: pstack-picks
plugins.description: Curated skills from poteto's pstack, rewritten for Claude Code: how/why, adversarial review, unslop, architect/arena/swarm, principles. Opt-in.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Graphify: turn a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph (/graphify). Needs the graphify CLI (uv tool install graphifyy). Opt-in.
